name: Implement is_palindrome
instruction: palindrome.py defines is_palindrome(s) as a stub that always returns False. Implement it so it returns True when the string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards) and False otherwise. The empty string is a palindrome. Comparison is case-sensitive and considers all characters.
verifyCmd: python3 -c "from palindrome import is_palindrome as p; import sys; sys.exit(0 if p('racecar') and p('') and not p('abc') and p('a') and not p('Racecar') else 1)"
